title: aurinia rupestris subsp. cyclocarpa
intro: Aurinia rupestris subsp. cyclocarpa, commonly known as Mountain Stock or Alpine Stock, is a plant species belonging to the family Brassicaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it useful in treating various ailments such as fever, wounds, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Aurinia rupestris subsp. cyclocarpa include its ability to reduce inflammation, fight off infections, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
